metadata.title: Global research data requirements and remaining skill gaps
metadata.geographic_requirement: Worldwide; no listing-market default. Match observations to company operating/customer/input exposure.
metadata.catalog_scope: Reusable source families and datasets across the twenty sector guides. A scoped requirements catalogue, not every possible vendor or a claim of complete live world coverage.
metadata.working_directory_review: Assessment of the eighteen bundled research skills and relevant references; no new live-agent benchmark was executed.
metadata.source_status: Official documentation/product/release pages reviewed. No new feed, subscription, API entitlement, bulk permission or production parser was established.
metadata.existing_adapters: The bundle contains adapters for AlphaPai, Alpha Vantage, API Ninjas and Massive. No credentials, universal country/field coverage or delivery rights are included; validate actual access before selecting a route.

gaps.name: Evidence-to-assumption construction and proxy calibration
gaps.state: Principles present; reusable calibrated implementation is thin
gaps.deliverable: A repeatable method and generic tools for exposure matching, lag/pass-through estimation, reference-class priors, uncertainty ranges and assumption sensitivity. Preserve a judgment path when history cannot support a fitted model.
gaps.acceptance: On an unfamiliar case, explain every decisive parameter from evidence/calibration, test a credible alternative and show why a broad indicator is or is not relevant. Use chronological holdouts; flag sparse data and structural breaks.
gaps.location: Extend company-model and evidence-intake; do not add a second forecasting owner.

gaps.name: Complete sector model engineering
gaps.state: Twenty short guides and arithmetic miniatures exist; full sector archetypes are not supplied
gaps.deliverable: Clean independent complete model archetypes: operating manufacturer/projects, subscription/cohorts, bank, insurer and drug-development model. Include appropriate statements/capital, cash, shares, periods and editable Excel.
gaps.acceptance: Perturb foundational assumptions and verify every statement/value consequence, realistic adverse behavior, timing, cash/funding and human readability. Do not force industrial net-debt/3S conventions onto banks or insurers.
gaps.location: Extend company-model scripts/assets and conditional sector references; build the first archetypes for actual research priorities.

gaps.name: Executed research-quality evaluation
gaps.state: Authored behavioral cases and deterministic tests exist; live research-quality results are not established
gaps.deliverable: A runnable benchmark and reviewer rubric for complete initiation, regular and earnings/catalyst updates using dated source packs and withheld review material.
gaps.acceptance: Evaluate source accuracy, assumption logic, accounting/cash, numerical integrity, interpretation, reproducibility and human model usability. Compare with analyst/broker examples without treating their forecasts as truth; flag historical knowledge leakage.
gaps.location: Extend evals and generic evaluation scripts; attach outcomes to the existing research cycle.

gaps.name: Independent evidence and economic model review
gaps.state: Challenge/review instructions exist; independent execution is not assured
gaps.deliverable: A reviewer procedure that reconstructs the decisive mechanism from original evidence, checks independent calculations and tests the strongest competing explanation.
gaps.acceptance: Catch plausible but unsupported mix, margin, timing and cash assumptions even when formulas balance. Distinguish a second self-review from an actual independent/blind assessment.
gaps.location: Strengthen research-challenge and financial-quality with review records and realistic failure cases.

gaps.name: Cross-country accounting, periods and shareholder-claim comparability
gaps.state: General standards/warnings exist; reusable country/accounting bridge assets are limited
gaps.deliverable: Conditional normalization/claim bridges covering fiscal calendars, reported/adjusted earnings, leases, capitalized costs, pension/capital rules, consolidation, minorities, currencies and share-class rights. Verify current country rules on real assignments.
gaps.acceptance: Reconcile materially different peers without blindly reusing standardized vendor ratios; preserve facts versus adjustments and quantify resulting forecast/value changes.
gaps.location: Extend actuals, financial-quality, governance and valuation references; assign one owner for each adjustment.

gaps.name: Joint scenarios and calibrated uncertainty
gaps.state: Scenario/probability principles exist; tested joint-driver implementations and empirical calibration are limited
gaps.deliverable: Coherent scenario libraries for coupled volume/price/margin/capital/rate/FX changes, explicit timing and downside survival. Use probability weights only where defensible.
gaps.acceptance: Avoid independent one-variable stresses presented as joint risk; show return with no rerating, funding consequences and how timing changes payoff. Qualitative uncertainty remains valid.
gaps.location: Extend company-model scenario helpers and valuation methods rather than create an independent EPS/value engine.

gaps.name: Forecast postmortems and reusable case judgment
gaps.state: A learning specification exists; a broad populated, validated reference-class history is not established
gaps.deliverable: Dated matched assumption/actual cases, management guidance/delivery histories and useful analogues, including failures, delistings, false exclusions and unresolved outcomes.
gaps.acceptance: Attribute misses by mechanism and original information availability. Distinguish correct reasoning from lucky prices and incorrect forecasts from external shocks. Do not claim predictive skill from a small selected archive.
gaps.location: Extend model-revision and monitor-review; keep case facts in research records outside generic skills.

gaps.name: Special situations and structural breaks
gaps.state: Generic catalyst/change handling exists; dedicated worked methods are not apparent
gaps.deliverable: Conditional methods for acquisitions/disposals, spin-offs, rights issues, recapitalizations, holding-company claims and distress/restructuring when a live case needs them.
gaps.acceptance: Bridge old/new business perimeter, consideration, debt/cash, dilution, rights, taxes/fees and alternative outcomes; avoid comparing incomparable EPS vintages or double-counting look-through assets.
gaps.location: Add focused references/fixtures under modeling, governance and valuation first; create a dedicated skill only if the recurring workflow warrants it.

priorities.name: Global identity, source registry and reproducibility
priorities.scope: GLEIF/OpenFIGI where useful, worldwide official-source/NSDP registry, market/currency calendars, identifiers, raw-vintage archive and observation contract.
priorities.proof: A restatement and delayed release can be replayed correctly at a frozen cutoff; country/source gaps remain visible.

priorities.name: Shared macro, trade, cost and public-disclosure backbone
priorities.scope: World Bank, IMF, BIS, OECD, UN Comtrade/WTO, UNIDO, ILO and commodity prices, plus country extensions and a reusable public filings/peer panel.
priorities.proof: Choose series by covered business exposure, not by the exchange where the stock is listed. Demonstrate units, definitions and publication/revision histories.

priorities.name: Sector observation modules
priorities.scope: Add matched units/price/capacity/input datasets for the sectors actually entering research: software/hardware/chips, financials, consumer, industrials, health, energy, property and transport.
priorities.proof: For each module, map observations to foundational drivers, identify what remains issuer-specific and reject at least one misleading proxy.

priorities.name: Targeted licensed gap-filling
priorities.scope: Trial one adequate global fundamentals/point-in-time estimates route and only decision-relevant sector products. Use existing entitlements where rights and delivery are sufficient.
priorities.proof: Compare sample coverage, vintages, definitions and incremental assumption usefulness before committing to a recurring product. This is not a shopping list.

priorities.name: Research-method work owned by us
priorities.scope: Assumption calibration, full sector archetypes, independent economic review and executed evaluations first; then cross-country bridges, scenarios and case learning.
priorities.proof: A real research exercise demonstrates the method and an inspectable model, rather than merely adding another instruction file.
